recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. A future cleanup sweep may consider removing unreferenced historical source files such as source/allergyintolerance/valueset-manifestation-codes.xml, but FHIR-12768 itself does not require a current-spec source fix.
issue_request: FHIR-12768 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care QA issue for DSTU2 requesting that AllergyIntolerance.reaction.manifestation bind to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/clinical-findings instead of the duplicate manifestation-codes value set.
initial_application: No current branch commit explicitly names FHIR-12768, but commit 3c31dbb2635f6e84603500902562d1e9911b28b2 changed the AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet binding from valueset-manifestation-codes to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/clinical-findings as part of QA work described as eliminating duplicate value sets. Later source refactoring carried that binding into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-31578 later changed AllergyIntolerance.reaction.manifestation to CodeableReference(Observation) and split the search parameters, but the clinical-findings binding remained. A stale source/allergyintolerance/valueset-manifestation-codes.xml file still exists, but current source content has no references to ValueSet/manifestation-codes or valueset-manifestation-codes, fhir.ini has no active valueset entry for it, and the current build returns 404 for the old value set page while the AllergyIntolerance profile exposes clinical-findings.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current implementer-facing specification already reflects the requested binding, and editing the unreferenced stale value set file would not change current conformance.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue changed the same element to CodeableReference(Observation) while preserving the clinical-findings binding.
